name: Capsule Pharmacy
notes: Tier 2. Researched from the public Capsule Questions (FAQ) page at capsule.com (no sign-in). When a new prescription or refill is ready, Capsule texts you to set up payment and schedule free delivery; the price is always shown before you schedule; delivery is free, so you pay only your insurance copay (all major insurance accepted). Sign in on the website or iOS app; FSA receipts are under Your Orders > View Receipt (export as PDF). Help by call or text at (888) 910-1808. Hand delivery in several U.S. cities; controlled substances need ID at delivery. Accepted payment methods are not published, so billing.methods is left to the family. Smart refills are coordinated by Capsule, but each delivery is paid when you schedule it; no AutoPay, guest payment, payment plan, paperless bill or future-dated payment is described (unsupported, inferred).

guest_pay.note: Capsule texts you a link to set up payment and schedule delivery when your prescription is ready. For help, call or text (888) 910-1808.

autopay.note: Capsule does not charge automatically: when each refill is ready we text you to set up payment and schedule your free delivery, and you always see the price first.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call or text Capsule at (888) 910-1808 with questions about a charge.

paperless.note: Capsule does not send bills; you pay when you schedule each delivery, and receipts are under Your Orders.

scheduled_payment.note: You pay when you schedule a delivery; future-dated payments are not offered.

help.title: Paying for your prescriptions
paragraphs: When a new prescription or a refill is ready, Capsule sends you a text to set up your payment and schedule your free delivery. Capsule always tells you what your prescription costs before you schedule.
Delivery is free, so you pay only your copay. Capsule accepts all major insurance, and your copay is the same as at any other pharmacy.
steps: Open the text from Capsule, or Sign in.
Review the price of your prescription.

help.title: Getting an FSA receipt
paragraphs: Sign in to Capsule on the website or iOS app and choose Your Orders from the menu. Open the order you need and select View Receipt; you can export the receipt as a PDF for your FSA.

help.title: How Capsule works
paragraphs: Ask your doctor to e-prescribe to Capsule, or give Capsule a few details and it transfers your refills from your old pharmacy, including your insurance information. Capsule fills the prescription and texts you to schedule delivery, and coordinates future refills with your doctor and insurer.

Couriers hand-deliver in several U.S. cities; someone needs to be there to receive the package, which is discreet and tamper sealed. Controlled substances need an ID check at delivery. You can manage medications for family members too. Call or text (888) 910-1808 for help.

extra.intent: I need an FSA receipt for a Capsule order. Where in my Capsule account do I find it? Answer from the Capsule help; don't pay or change anything.

solution.text: Your Orders > open the order > View Receipt (export as PDF).
